title: Check stock availability before promising a delivery
instruction: A customer wants 40 units of Roller Chain RC80 (PRD-012) from Warehouse North (WH-001). Check whether that is available today. If it is not, adjust nothing — instead raise a purchase requisition for the reorder quantity against the Operations MRO budget (BUD-002), requested by Tom Braddock (USR-004) for the Warehouse Operations department (DEPT-OPS).
